name: Old Blue City & Clock Tower
tagline: Indigo lanes beneath the towering fort
description: The historic walled quarter of blue-washed Brahmin houses winding below Mehrangarh Fort, centred on the Ghanta Ghar clock tower and the bustling Sardar Market. Narrow lanes, rooftop cafes and heritage guesthouses fill this dense, photogenic core of Jodhpur.
bestFor: Travellers wanting fort views, rooftop cafes and immersive old-city street life

name: Sardarpura
description: A planned residential and commercial district west of the old city with wide, gridded streets, banks, restaurants, coffee shops and shopping. Sardarpura offers a calmer, more modern base with reliable amenities while staying within easy reach of the historic centre.
bestFor: Longer-stay nomads wanting amenities, quieter streets and everyday conveniences

name: Ratanada
description: A greener, upmarket neighbourhood in southern Jodhpur close to Umaid Bhawan Palace, hosting hotels, the airport road and spacious residential colonies. Ratanada suits visitors preferring comfortable stays, wider roads and a more relaxed setting away from old-city congestion.
bestFor: Comfort-focused travellers near the palace wanting space and quieter surroundings

name: Near Mehrangarh & Navchokiya
description: The steep cluster of lanes and blue houses of Navchokiya on the fort's western flank, dotted with small guesthouses and rooftop restaurants that face Mehrangarh. It is quieter than the clock tower yet delivers some of the city's best fort-facing views.
bestFor: Photographers and slow travellers wanting fort views away from market crowds
